summary: Server-backed inbox search/filter/group + personal view, with honest counts and truncation notices. Fix-forward closed the UX-facing correctness defects (badge<->list agreement, stale-response flicker, phantom load-more in grouped mode). No new UUID renders, no jargon, kit-tokens only.

checks.badge_vs_list_honesty: PASS — per-tab counts computed over the filtered base; grouped-mode group badges sum exactly to the rendered rows (server returns whole capped set, not a page). A badge of N never sits over a smaller/empty list.
checks.truncation_notice_honest: PASS — grouped mode over the 500-row cap renders «Показаны первые N задач — уточните поиск или фильтр…» from groupTruncated/groupRowCap rather than silently dropping rows.
checks.no_phantom_loadmore: PASS — «Показать ещё» gated on !groupByProcess; in grouped mode the whole set is already present.
checks.stale_response_flicker: PASS — monotonic loadSeq token drops out-of-order responses; the list no longer flickers to stale data when q-debounce and a tab switch race.
checks.collapsed_group_state: PASS — collapsedGroups pruned to live group keys on filter/tab change; a reappearing process no longer restores a wrong collapsed state.
checks.whole_row_clickable_keyboard: PASS (AC-5.1) — nested controls stopPropagation; row keyboard-operable (test present).
checks.anti_uuid: PASS — ci/checks/ux/anti-uuid-actor-render.sh exit 0; list row/drawer render ProcessRef/RecordRef/StepRef, never bare machine keys (procKey carried only as a filter/group axis, never rendered primary).
checks.no_jargon_no_hardcode: PASS — app.css +86 lines passed ux-g6 hardcode gate (within the fitness bundle); D-064 anti-case gate clean (no persona/role literals added).
checks.personal_view_persist: PASS (AC-7) — columns+density persist via user_pref store; personal view needs no configurator privilege.

non_blocking.finding: The grouped-mode truncation notice copy is only reachable above 500 filtered rows; not visually exercised in tests. Acceptable — copy is plain Russian, token-styled, and the info icon is from the kit.
